title: Secure Internal Knowledge Synthesis
business: A regional legal firm handling sensitive client documents that cannot be uploaded to public cloud AI services.
problem: The firm struggles with fragmented document storage and the inability to query internal case files securely, leading to significant time loss during legal research.
solution: Deploying Open WebUI as a self-hosted interface allows the firm to connect local, offline models to their internal document repositories, ensuring all data processing remains within their private infrastructure.
steps: Provision a secure server instance within the firm's private network.
Install Open WebUI using Docker to maintain a stateless, scalable architecture.
Configure the interface to point to a local Ollama instance for model inference.
Upload sensitive legal documents into the Open WebUI knowledge base for RAG-based querying.
Enable user authentication to ensure only authorized legal staff access the interface.
outcome: Legal staff gain the ability to perform rapid, secure semantic searches across internal case files without risking data exposure to external cloud providers.
limitation: The primary limitation is the reliance on local hardware resources for inference; users can check performance by monitoring system latency during complex document retrieval tasks.
